collaboration.no_view_permission: Your account does not have permission to view this content.
collaboration.organization_explainer: Real accounts establish organization identity. Team membership and project access are managed separately.
collaboration.organization_view_notice: Your account can view its authorized scope. Owners and administrators manage organization members and invitations.
collaboration.organization_roles_notice: The server checks owner protection and current permissions for each member role change.
collaboration.members_empty_help: The member list follows organization permissions.
collaboration.invitation_delivery: Invitations expire after 24 hours. Deliver each invitation yourself; the system does not send email.
collaboration.no_pregrants: No project access granted in advance
collaboration.invitations_empty_help: Invitations are tied to an email address. Acceptance requires account password verification.
collaboration.invite_modal_help: You can grant project access within this organization in advance. The invitation is shown once; deliver it securely yourself.
collaboration.manage_account_help: Removing a member revokes their organization sessions and project access. At least one owner must remain.
collaboration.revoke_invitation_help: This invitation can no longer be accepted after it is revoked.
collaboration.account_missing: This account is no longer in the organization.
collaboration.remove_organization_access: Remove from organization and revoke access
collaboration.confirm_owner_transfer: Confirm transferring owner permissions to this account
collaboration.clipboard_unavailable: The clipboard is unavailable. Copy the content below manually.
collaboration.invitation_created_secret_: Invitation created. Its secret is not shown again.
collaboration.token_memory_notice: The token is held only in this dialog’s memory. It cannot be retrieved from the list after closing.
collaboration.invitation_recovered: The original creation completed. Its receipt does not expose the secret again. If you did not save the token, revoke this invitation and create another.
collaboration.team_access_notice: Team membership does not automatically grant project access.
collaboration.no_email: The system does not send email
collaboration.teams_explainer: Teams can include real accounts, agents, and tools. Team membership supports collaboration and does not automatically grant project access.
collaboration.teams_subtitle: Organize people and capabilities by responsibility
collaboration.teams_empty_help: Create a team to define responsibilities for collaboration within the organization.
collaboration.team_description_missing: A team description has not been provided.
collaboration.team_unavailable: The team does not exist or is unavailable to your account
collaboration.team_unavailable_help: Choose again from the current organization’s team list.
collaboration.choose_team_help: View team members and add real accounts, project agents, or tools.
collaboration.team_modal_help: Teams define organization structure. Manage project access separately on the project access page.
collaboration.team_members_empty: This team has no members yet
collaboration.team_members_empty_help: Add existing organization accounts, agents, or tools from projects in the current organization.
collaboration.membership_modal_help: Choose an existing identity. This action does not create an account or grant project access.
collaboration.remove_team_member: Remove this member from the team
collaboration.project_access_independent: Project access grants are separate from organization and team roles.
collaboration.project_access_explainer: Grant real organization accounts access to this project. Organization owners and administrators also have inherited access.
collaboration.project_access_managers: Organization owners, administrators, or project administrators manage access grants. The server validates every role change.
collaboration.no_explicit_grants_help: The server still determines organization permissions. You can grant project roles to specific accounts here.
collaboration.project_grant_modal_help: Manage only accounts in the current organization. You cannot grant roles above your own permissions.
collaboration.revoke_account_access: Revoke this account’s explicit project access
collaboration.accept_invitation_help: Verify your identity with the invited email address. Existing accounts must use their current password; new accounts must set a password with at least 12 characters. Existing account passwords will not be changed.
collaboration.accept_unknown: The acceptance result has not been confirmed. One-time invitations are not retried automatically. Sign in with the invited email and account password to check organization membership. If the invitation remains valid, you can return to this page manually.
collaboration.login_recover: Go to sign in to recover your session
collaboration.invitation_token_hint: Paste the token you received. Links read the token only from the #invite fragment and do not accept automatically.
collaboration.existing_name_hint: Existing accounts keep their original name.
collaboration.accept_confirmation: Confirm accepting the organization invitation with this account
collaboration.planning_explainer: Delivery completion is based on task acceptance. Schedules, estimates, and execution records are retained separately.
collaboration.iterations_empty_help: Set iteration goals and dates, then schedule real delivery tasks into the iteration.
collaboration.milestones_empty_help: Define key delivery dates and link milestones in task schedules.
collaboration.scope_modal_help: Completion requires all linked tasks to pass acceptance. The server validates dates and status.
collaboration.schedule_modal_help: Selected tasks are saved as one batch. Task and plan versions are checked, and updates apply only after the entire batch succeeds.
collaboration.baseline_modal_help: Save an immutable snapshot of all current tasks, schedules, estimates, and delivery states.
collaboration.no_iteration_goal: An iteration goal has not been provided.
collaboration.no_delivery_description: A delivery description has not been provided.
collaboration.scope_incomplete: The full task scope is not loaded. The server checks the completion gate.
collaboration.scope_accepted: All linked tasks have been accepted. Completion can be requested.
collaboration.scope_acceptance_required: All linked tasks must be accepted before completion.
collaboration.scope_missing: This plan no longer exists. Keep your draft before closing.
collaboration.title: Title
collaboration.plan_status_help: Selecting completed checks every linked task. Plan status does not replace task acceptance.
collaboration.schedule_latest_missing: The latest plan for the selected task was not loaded. Your draft has been kept.
collaboration.estimated_hours_hint: Leave blank for unknown; 0 explicitly means no work is required.
collaboration.timeline_help: Select tasks to schedule them in a batch. Each timeline provides the same dates as text and an edit button. Tasks without start and due dates remain unscheduled.
collaboration.tasks_empty_help: Create delivery tasks on the tasks page, then set their iterations, dates, and estimates.
collaboration.baseline_placeholder: For example: Scope committed for this iteration
collaboration.baselines_subtitle: Choose a commitment and compare current delivery
collaboration.baselines_empty_help: Capture the current baseline to preserve this planning commitment.
collaboration.choose_baseline_help: Compare task scope, schedules, estimates, and actual acceptance states.
collaboration.outside_loaded_scope: Not in the currently loaded scope
collaboration.capacity_explainer: Human planning hours are separate from agent execution slots and machine quotas. Blank capacity means unknown.
collaboration.capacity_not_loaded: Capacity for this week has not been loaded
collaboration.capacity_not_loaded_help: This week’s data is unavailable. Reload it before setting capacity.
collaboration.no_capacity_resources: No resources available for planning yet
collaboration.no_capacity_resources_help: Register humans, agents, or tools on the project resources page, then set weekly capacity.
collaboration.capacity_modal_help: Record planning hours for each project resource. Leave blank to restore unknown capacity.
collaboration.available_hours_hint: Leave blank when unknown; enter 0 when no time is available.
collaboration.rebase_task_missing: This task is no longer in the current project scope. Check it before removing this item.
collaboration.week_navigation_blocked: The current operation is not complete. The original capacity week has been kept.
collaboration.invalid_capacity_week: The capacity week must start on a valid Monday.
collaboration.invalid_hours: Hours must be a nonnegative number. Leave blank when unknown.
collaboration.compare_unloaded: Not loaded on the current page
collaboration.confirm_remove_member: Confirm removing {{name}} from the organization and revoking their project access
collaboration.revoke_invitation_confirm: Confirm revoking the invitation sent to {{email}}.
collaboration.resources_loaded: Loaded {{loaded}} / {{total}} project resources; only matching types are shown.
collaboration.planning_coverage: Task scope: {{loaded}} / {{total}} loaded. Statistics cover all tasks in the current project; cards and timelines show only loaded tasks. Read at {{time}}.
collaboration.capture_scope_notice: The server captures all tasks in the current project ({{total}} in this read). The saved baseline is immutable; later scope and acceptance changes are compared separately.
collaboration.baseline_comparison_notice: Comparison totals cover the server’s full scope. The table compares the loaded snapshot with current tasks. Task definitions changed: {{total}}.
collaboration.capacity_scope_notice: Current capacity week: {{week}}. Scheduled estimates include only tasks with estimated hours; unestimated tasks cannot be counted as 0 hours. Known estimates below capacity do not establish that the complete plan is feasible.
collaboration.invalid_week_retained: Choose a valid Monday. {{previous}} has been kept.
collaboration.authorized_accounts_only: Only organization accounts with existing project access are shown.
collaboration.accounts_server_check: The list contains real organization accounts. The server verifies project access.
collaboration.current_identity_recheck: {{name}} · Currently linked; permissions must be checked again
collaboration.resource_identity_help: New coworkers first <invite>accept an organization invitation</invite>, then <grant>receive project access</grant>. This form links existing identities only.
collaboration.responsibility_hint: Responsibilities define the division of work. Manage permissions through project access grants.
collaboration.identity_read_failed: Unable to load real organization accounts: {{reason}}
